s: Mi hu hambarek ubo h' seipim: gadol bechokma shebbekol hamsubbin, hu yebarek birkat hammazon lekullam, apillu im ba besop hasseuda. Veim rotzeh litten reshut leqatan lebarek — hareshut beyado. Veim haggadol motzi lecha (sheqqorin hvsh"t) — yebarek acher, ki zeh en nakon sheyyapsiq peamim rabbot veyihyeh roqeq vaacherim yamtinu:

Chakam yisrael qodem lekohen apillu sheeno chakam kemoto, ap al pi shehu gam ken talmid chakam. Umikkol maqom, tob sheyyimchol yisrael hechakam al kebodo veyaqdimo hakkohen lebarek, velo yebarek lepanayv, kevan shehakkohen gam ken talmid chakam. Vehaoseh ken maarik yamim. Abal lekohen am haaretz asur lehaqdim derek choq umishpat kehunna, mishshum bizyon hattora, ki maalatah gedola mimmaalat hakkehunna. Abal im hechakam noten lo reshut lebarek kak belo choq umishpat kehunna — muttar. Vaapillu im hechakam hu kohen vehaam haaretz hu yisrael:

Kohen veyisrael shehem shavin bechokma, mitzvat aseh min hattora lehaqdim hakkohen, shenneemar "veqiddashto", vedareshu chakamim: lekol dabar shebbiqdushsha, kelomar bekol dabar sheyyeraeh gadol hu mequddash, kegon liptoach rishon biqriat hattora, velihyot rosh hamdabberim bekol qibbutz am ledabber velidrosh techilla, veken bayyeshiba yedabber barosh, veken basseuda hu qodem lebarek "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon, velitten lo mana yapa battechilla lekol hamsubbin. Ella im ken yesh yisrael gadol mimmennu bechokma, azay yittenu lehechakam mana hayyapa techilla. Vetzarik lizzaher bekol ellu shehem min hattora. Abal keshehakkohen choleq ezeh shuttaput im chabero yisrael — en tzarik litten lo hacheleq hayyapeh, sheen zeh derek kabod sheyyittol cheleq hayyapeh, shekkol hannoten enayv bacheleq hayyapeh — eno roeh siman beraka leolam. Ubemaqom sheen kohen, tob lehaqdim gam ken hallevi leyisrael bekol ellu im hem shavin bechokma (vehaoseh ken maarik yamim. Abal en chiyyub baddabar, shello neemar "veqiddashto" ella bekohen, "ki et lechem eloheka hu maqrib vego'"):

Bammeh debarim amurim shehechakam qodem lekohen vekohen lelevi velevi leyisrael lebarek birkat hammazon? Keshekkol hamsubbin hem baale battim veen sham oreach, o shekkullam orechim veen sham baal habbayit meseb immahem. Abal oreach ubaal habbayit, apillu baal habbayit hu kohen vegadol bechokma — haoreach mebarek, kede sheyyebarek lebaal habbayit. Umah beraka meborko? "Yehi ratzon shello yebosh velo yikkalem baal habbayit hazzeh lo baolam hazzeh velo baolam habba, veyatzliach bekol nekasayv, veyihyu nekasayv mutzlachim uqerobim lair, velo yishlot satan bemaase yadayv, veal yizdaqqer lepanayv shum debar chete veavon meatta vead olam". Umikkol maqom, im haoreach eno hagun beene baal habbayit — rashshay lehaabir mimmennu habberaka velitteno leechad mibbene beto, apillu lo yebarekennu, kegon shehu samuk al shulchano besakar, sheen tzarik lebarek lebaal habbayit. Vaapillu hu hagun beenayv verotzeh levatter al birkato ulebarek beatzmo — hareshut beyado:

Veoreach shennotenim lo lebarek veeno mebarek — meqatztzer yamayv, mishshum shennimna lebarek et baal habbayit, shehu mizzera abraham shenneemar bo: "vaaborka mebarekeka", umikkelal hen atta shomea lav. Vegam kol adam yesh lo lachazor sheyyittenu lo kos shel beraka lebarek birkat hammazon bezimmun, velo lishmoa velaanot "amen", sheap shehashshomea keoneh, veoneh "amen" kemotzi beraka mippiv, mikkol maqom, memaharin litten sakar techilla lehambarek:
